stories.title: Ukraine confirms strike on Russian warship in Libya
stories.detail: Kyiv said its attack sank the corvette. Libyan officials confirmed severe damage in Benghazi on 22 Nov.
stories.date_note: Strike 22 Nov. Ukrainian president confirmed responsibility 23 Nov; AP reported at 07:48 UTC. Kyiv's claim of sinking is attributed separately.

stories.title: Iran vows to resist U.S. oil blockade
stories.detail: Tehran says it will use all available means to counter the naval blockade.
stories.date_note: Foreign ministry briefing on Monday. Reuters first dispatch at 07:59 UTC.

stories.title: Asia's chip trade splits
stories.detail: KOSPI falls 3.3% while Taiwan's Taiex gains 2.2% amid AI-stock turmoil.
stories.date_note: 23 Nov market moves in AP's evolving Monday dispatch.

stories.title: Gaza contamination mapped
stories.detail: Oxfam found contamination indicators across over 99% of Gaza.

stories.title: Pacific reacts to COP failure
stories.detail: Pacific voices and Australian critics respond after Sunday's talks ended without a broad deal.
stories.date_note: COP31 closed 22 Nov; Monday's Australian and Pacific reaction is the item.

stories.title: Perm refinery hit
stories.detail: Officials reported a refinery fire and one death in the Perm region.

stories.title: Shuri Castle reopens
stories.detail: Okinawa's restored main hall opens to visitors seven years after the fire.

stories.title: Deep M6.5 Pacific quake
stories.detail: The quake struck at 02:40 UTC, about 598 km deep.

stories.title: Strike grounds flights
stories.detail: A nationwide strike disrupts Brussels and Charleroi airports and city transit.

stories.title: Durban clears medicine cargo
stories.detail: The operator cleared 18 urgently needed containers and expects more shipments.
stories.date_note: The port operator disclosed the release in a Monday statement.

stories.title: Deadly strike in Hodeida
stories.detail: Houthi-run ministry reports six dead and 18 wounded in western Yemen.
stories.date_note: Monday casualty account; the toll is attributed and can change.

stories.title: Seoul names new ministers
stories.detail: Cabinet reshuffle includes nominees for the foreign and unification ministries.

stories.title: Thailand traces river arsenic
stories.detail: Bangkok will present evidence linking border-river contamination to mines upstream.

stories.title: ICE expands plate-reader use
stories.detail: New reporting describes broader vehicle surveillance in immigration enforcement.
stories.date_note: Original reporting appeared on 23 Nov at 11:00 UTC; the investigation covers earlier activity.

stories.title: Chile's peso under pressure
stories.detail: The Monday report puts a dollar above 1,000 Chilean pesos.

stories.title: Eurozone composite PMI stays at 51.7
stories.detail: The flash survey points to modest private-sector growth.

stories.title: China asks Switzerland to help ease EU trade rift
stories.detail: Beijing raised trade and Taiwan in talks with the Swiss foreign minister.

stories.title: UK publishes France removals inspection
stories.detail: Inspectors say escorts were generally well organised.

stories.title: UN opens business and rights forum
stories.detail: The Geneva gathering runs for three days.

stories.title: Strasbourg plenary due to open
stories.detail: The European Parliament lists a 17:00 local start.

stories.title: NASA profiles Arctic satellite laser ranging
stories.detail: The new Earth Observatory feature looks at how scientists track satellites from the Arctic.

stories.title: Severe storms forecast in eastern South Africa
stories.detail: Forecasters warned of intense rain.

stories.title: Investigation traces Atlantic migrant deaths
stories.detail: A Brazilian inquiry worked to identify bodies from a boat bound for Europe.

stories.title: Australia moves to freeze A$25 prescription cap
stories.detail: Legislation would extend the cap through 2030.

stories.title: Singapore PM begins visit to Australia
stories.detail: The annual leaders' meeting is on the itinerary.

stories.title: Hai Phong starts two $1bn projects
stories.detail: Work includes four new berths and a materials plant.

stories.title: Ho Chi Minh City presents 2050 plan
stories.detail: Long-range plan sets out a digital and industrial hub.

stories.title: Islamabad sets nuclear-security forum
stories.detail: IAEA network meeting is set for 23–26 November.

stories.title: Indonesia moves vice-presidential vote to Dec. 11
stories.detail: The assembly announced the date change on Monday.

stories.title: Vietnam Red Cross marks 80 years
stories.detail: The anniversary ceremony takes place on Monday.

stories.title: Canada sets digital core-scanning announcement
stories.detail: Natural Resources Canada scheduled the Monday event.

stories.title: Overnight storm floods Rio streets
stories.detail: Local radio reported street flooding early Monday, with more rain forecast.

stories.title: Mexico due to publish third-quarter GDP
stories.detail: EFE listed the release for Monday. Result pending at cutoff.

stories.title: Argentina marks sovereignty holiday
stories.detail: The National Sovereignty Day observance falls on Monday.

stories.title: U.S. stock futures climb before opening
stories.detail: Futures rebound after Friday's technology sell-off.

stories.title: Tokyo cash equities shut for holiday
stories.detail: Monday trading pauses for Labor Thanksgiving Day.

stories.title: France revisits constitutional debt rules
stories.detail: The president floated reviving a 2011 fiscal proposal.

date_check: Strike 22 Nov; Kyiv confirms role on 23 Nov.
Closed 22 Nov; Pacific reaction reported on 23 Nov.
U.S. House tally and WHO Congo appeal: 22 Nov.
Kyiv-area attack and Amazon rescue: 22 Nov.
